reference.creator: Valve Corporation
reference.retrieval_note: The official GitLab endpoint returned an anti-bot access denial. The published files were inspected from a public mirror; this is not a separately authenticated factory drawing.
reference.use: Sparse dimensional facts and feature counts used to reconstruct primitives. No Valve faces, wires, meshes, reference drawings or STEP data embedded or redistributed in the project.

published_dimensions_mm.basis: Reference drawing sheet 2. Supersedes the previous exact-7-inch geometric conversion of 150.77 x 94.23 mm.

measured_reference_features.coordinate_basis: X/Y reference front coordinates; front surface near Z0. Current model front datum Z37 is retained as a construction parameter.

speakers.note: The middle row has one longer inner opening. Side fields are mirrored; rim cross sections are reconstructed approximations.

top_exhaust.note: Overall slot height and local rim geometry reconstructed; the 56.5 mm drawing annotation is an accessory keepout, not aperture width.

ambient_light_sensor.presence: Identified by Valve drawing detail E
ambient_light_sensor.position_basis: Centerline and 1.3 mm drawing offset from the cover edge, interpreted in the model coordinates
ambient_light_sensor.diameter_basis: Estimate; no physical aperture diameter located in the reference STEP.

keepout_distinctions: Microphone diameter 2 mm is accessory clearance, not its physical hole diameter.
Ambient-light sensor diameter 3 mm is accessory clearance, not its physical optical window diameter.
Exhaust 56.5 mm and speaker 20.1 x 10.1 mm annotations are keepout regions.
limitations: No hardware sample measured. Reference CAD is a public external-topology release, not a manufacturing tolerance model.
Published 298 x 117 x 49 mm overall envelope retained; measured public CAD extents differ slightly from the rounded product specification.
Existing enclosure curvature, shell thickness, control travel and internal electronic/thermal layout remain approximate.

Trackpad, lower system-key and speaker support parts move with their exterior features; these internal shapes are not verified factory designs. Microphone package depth is moved 1.3 mm above the previous schematic layer to clear the existing antenna foil; that depth is not measured from Valve exterior CAD.
The corrected exhaust row does not establish that the existing schematic heat exchanger and duct layout reproduce actual airflow or factory geometry.
